jobs.title: Product Owner - Website Conversion & Growth
jobs.description:
Posted on
August 5th, 2026
Location
Hyderabad
Type
Full\-time, Permanent
Experience
2 \- 4 years
Open Positions
1
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a data driven, customer focused Product Owner to own the experience and performance of our high traffic lead generation website. Every visitor interaction on our site, from landing page to form submission, directly drives revenue. This role sits at the intersection of UI/UX, data analysis, and Agile product delivery.
  

You will be the person who looks at a funnel drop off, forms a hypothesis about why it is happening, designs a test to validate it, and works with design and engineering to ship the fix, then measures the impact. This is not a role for someone who just writes tickets. It is for someone who thinks like a conversion strategist and executes like a Product Owner.
### **What You Will Do:**


#### **Conversion Optimization and Product Analytics (Core Focus):**


* Own the performance of key website funnels, including landing pages, forms, and conversion paths, with conversion rate as your north star metric.
* Analyze user behavior, session data, drop off points, and on site engagement to identify friction and opportunity.
* Form data backed hypotheses and translate them into a prioritized experimentation roadmap.
* Define, launch, and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests, and make clear ship, kill, or iterate calls based on results.
* Partner with design and engineering to turn insights into shipped UI/UX improvements such as page layout, form design, copy, page speed, mobile experience, and trust signals.
* Report on outcomes in terms stakeholders care about, including conversion lift, lead volume, lead quality, and revenue impact.

#### **Product Vision and Roadmap:**


* Translate business goals, such as more leads, better lead quality, and higher conversion, into a clear, prioritized backlog.
* Build and maintain a roadmap focused on funnel and website enhancements.
* Keep an eye on competitor sites and industry UX and CRO trends, and bring relevant ideas back to the team.

#### **Requirements and Documentation:**


* Turn business needs and test hypotheses into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare lightweight, useful Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) that are clear enough for engineering and design to build from, without unnecessary overhead.
* Maintain release notes and document key product and test decisions and their outcomes, so learnings compound over time.

#### **Stakeholder Management:**


* Act as the main link between business stakeholders and the development team.
* Present roadmap progress and experiment results in a way that is clear to both technical and non technical audiences.
* Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and trade offs, and know when to push back on a request that will not move the needle on conversion.

#### **Qualification \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Design, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 to 4 years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, CRO Specialist, or similar role, ideally with direct exposure to high traffic websites, landing pages, or lead generation funnels.
* A track record of using data to improve conversion, not just shipping features, but proving they worked.
* Solid experience with Agile/Scrum, including backlog management, sprint planning, and writing detailed user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience with website conversion optimization strongly preferred.

#### **Skills:**


* Strong grasp of UI/UX principles and how design decisions affect user behavior and conversion.
* Comfortable reading and interpreting web analytics, session recordings, heatmaps, and A/B test results to draw actionable conclusions. Specific tools matter less than the underlying analytical thinking.
* Working knowledge of Agile tooling such as JIRA or similar. This is a good to have, not a must have, as long as you understand iterative, sprint based product development.
* Basic technical literacy, including an understanding of APIs, databases, and web architecture well enough to have informed conversations with engineering.

#### **How You Work:**


* Genuinely customer centric. You want to understand why users behave the way they do, not just what the numbers say.
* Strong communicator who can present data and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at every level.
* Decisive prioritizer, comfortable making trade off calls with incomplete information.
* Leads through influence. You will not manage this team directly, but you drive alignment and momentum anyway.
* Comfortable in a fast moving environment where hypotheses get tested and iterated quickly.
**Email your resume to recruitment@haystek.com**

jobs.title: Sales Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Join Thomson Reuters' high\-performing Sales organization as a Sales Operations Specialist, where you'll be the go\-to partner enabling Sales to execute faster, smarter, and with greater confidence. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data, process, and stakeholder support—turning complex policies, pricing, and performance insights into clear actions that drive revenue outcomes.


**About the Role:**
-------------------

In this opportunity as Sales Operations Specialist, you will:


* Serves as a primary resource for sales consultants, account managers and sales management to understand content/product offerings, business policies, commissions, promotions, incentives and procedures for all pre\-sale issues.
* Develops data /content and recommendations for all exceptions to presentation to the exception committee
* Conducts monthly and ad\-hoc operation reporting and analysis.
* Consults with Sales managers to resolve problems and interprets information/policies and procedures.
* When necessary and appropriate, communicates pricing and product information to customers directly.
* Monitors data and provides analysis to illustrate sales trends, identify weaknesses in current sales execution and support future sales strategy.
* Manages the coordination and investigation of order processing activities, fulfillment, compensation and other requests during and at end of month.
* May provide logistical support for national and regional sales meetings and other events as needed
* Consults with management on the effect of policies and procedures on business goals and assists in developing and implementing policy and procedure.
* Identifies opportunities to apply Agentic AI and automation to Sales Ops workflows—such as case triage, exception handling, and reporting—and partners with technical teams to design and pilot these solutions.
* Builds and maintains AI\-assisted tools (e.g., self\-service data lookups, automated report generation) that reduce manual turnaround time for sales support requests.

* Work Mode: 3 days from office.
* Shift Timing: 12pm IST to 9pm IST/2pm IST to 11pm IST

**About You:**
--------------

You're a fit for the role of Sales Operations Specialist, if your background includes:


* Experience Required: 4\+ Years of relevant experience into end to end Sales Operations with a background in Order to Cash process or Lead to Cash process
* Strong proficiency in Excel (intermediate to advanced level).
* Hands\-on experience working with Salesforce and SAP.
* Ability to analyze sales data and deliver meaningful insights, reports, and dashboards for the team and leadership.

* Ability to translate a manual, repetitive Sales Ops process into an automation or agentic\-AI solution requirement, working with technical/IT partners to scope and implement it.

\#LI\-GS2

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* **Making a Real\-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

jobs.title: SAP Release Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 1 year of experience with release engineering in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with software configuration management systems or source code version control systems.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Certification in CloudALM or SAP Solution Manager and knowledge of SAP ABAP or Fiori technical environments.
* Experience in implementation of ChaRM customizations.
* Experience in managing SOX controls and audits in Release Management.
* Experience with ChaRM, STMS and SAP RISE specific transports management.
* Extensive functional experience in CloudALM.
* Extensive functional experience in SAP ChaRM implementations and operations support.

**About the job**
-----------------


How do you release updates and changes to the world's most trafficked sites without users ever noticing a glitch in service? Our Release Engineering team takes on this very challenge. As a member of the team, you work with Software Engineers to ensure our services and products seamlessly move from development through rollout and into production. This requires scripting and coding with an eye toward scalability so that big deployments can be broken down and distributed across multiple data centers. You are a excited by massively complex systems and the challenges that come from working with some of the largest computing systems in the world. From changing the look of Google Search to backend tweaks to our algorithms, we are constantly pushing updates and iterating on all of our products. The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Analyze business needs to architect and deploy enhancements for SAP Solution Manager 7\.2 (ChaRM), using visual workflows to improve the processes.
* Manage the transport life\-cycle across on\-premise and RISE environments, leading deployments, risk assessments, and Change Control Boards (CCBs) to ensure project cutovers.
* Implement a comprehensive SAP ChaRM framework by leveraging cCTS\+ for cross\-platform orchestration and utilizing CSOL, Retrofit, and ATC to ensure synchronized deployments across the S/4HANA and integrated application landscape.
* Serve as the functional lead for SAP Solution Manager (ChaRM), managing the entire life cycle of changes, from configuring transport systems (cCTS/CTS\+) and defining best practices to coordinating releases and resolving functional discrepancies.
* Drive technical initiatives like HANA upgrades, RISE migrations, and CI/CD integration while ensuring tool interoperability and IT compliance.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**We're looking for a**
**Software Engineer**
=====================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Job Title:** Software Engineer
  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India
  

**Years of Experience:** **3\- 4 years of hands\-on software engineering experience**, building and operating production systems


**Position Overview**
---------------------


We are seeking a **Software Engineer** to design, build, and scale high\-quality software systems that power our product platforms. This role is ideal for a strong, hands\-on engineer with solid backend fundamentals, cloud experience, and growing exposure to AI\-driven development.


The ideal candidate has **strong experience with Java and AWS**, good experience working on **React** , a good understanding of **SQL and NoSQL data stores**, and an interest or hands\-on experience integrating **AI or Generative AI capabilities** into real\-world applications. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that drive customer value.


### **In this role you will...**


### **Software Development \& System Design**


* Design, implement, and maintain **backend services and APIs** using Java and modern frameworks.
* Build and operate **cloud\-native services on AWS**, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Develop and expose **API\-first services** using REST and GraphQL.
* Contribute to system design discussions and help implement scalable, distributed architectures.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code following engineering best practices.
* Design and implement application UI using **React, Typescript**

### **Data \& Platform Engineering**


* Design and work with **SQL and NoSQL databases** to support high\-scale application workloads.
* Implement data access patterns with a focus on performance, reliability, and consistency.
* Contribute to event\-driven and asynchronous processing where appropriate.

### **AI\-Aware Development**


* Integrate **AI or ML capabilities** into applications, including LLM\-based features or intelligent automation.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and architects on **AI\-enabled system designs**.
* Apply best practices for using AI services safely, reliably, and cost\-effectively.

### **Cloud, DevOps \& Quality**


* Deploy and operate services on AWS using **Docker and Kubernetes (EKS)**.
* Contribute to **CI/CD pipelines**, automated testing, and infrastructure automation.
* Monitor, debug, and optimize production systems.
* Partner with QA, DevOps, and Security teams to ensure quality and compliance.

### **Collaboration \& Growth**


* Work closely with Product Managers, UX designers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver customer\-facing features.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute positively to team culture.

### **You’ve got what it takes if you have…**


### **Required**


* **3\- 4 years of hands\-on software engineering experience** building production systems.
* Strong experience with **Java** in backend and service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong experience with **React, Typescript** and frontend development
* Hands\-on experience with **AWS** (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.).
* Experience working with **SQL and NoSQL databases** in production.
* Experience building **RESTful APIs**; exposure to GraphQL is a plus.
* Experience with **Docker**; exposure to Kubernetes (EKS) is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a quality\-first mindset.

We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 We are looking for a talented individual contributor to join a cross\-functional product team responsible for integrating the Order \& Portfolio Management System with the broader platform ecosystem and building new O/PMS features, with a focus on seamless trade lifecycle workflows from order creation through to position synchronization, reconciliation, and post\-trade processing.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own features from concept to delivery across the trade lifecycle, producing roadmaps and feature specifications through domain deep\-dives and requirements gathering for order workflows, FIX connectivity, allocation logic, and portfolio analytics.
* Articulate product value propositions drawing on knowledge of order routing, execution management, portfolio construction, and position keeping.
* Partner with engineers, architects, and platform partners to translate specs into product, bridging trading desk workflows and back\-office accounting while coordinating timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across integration workstreams.
* Build comprehensive test cases covering order routing, execution, position synchronization, data mapping, exception handling, and end\-to\-end integration.
* Conduct competitor analysis across the OMS/PMS/EMS landscape.


**What You'll Need**
* 8\+ years in front, middle, and/or back\-office; 4\+ years in product management.
* 2\+ years of direct experience working with OMS and/or PMS platforms, covering order creation, routing, execution, allocation, and settlement.
* Familiarity with how OMS/PMS platforms interact with execution venues, prime brokers, fund administrators, and accounting engines.
* Experience collaborating with engineers in an agile environment.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams with diligence.
* Graduate degree in software engineering, finance, or a related quantitative field.


 Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.
   

  

**Recruiting Security**
 Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers\-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers\-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
   

  

*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Product Manager, Senior - JustGiving
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
* We’re looking for a strategic, impact\-driven Senior Product Manager to lead product development across the JustGiving platform. You’ll drive bold thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and measurable outcomes, helping reshape how millions of fundraisers and thousands of non\-profits engage.
* You’ll own strategy, delivery and continuous improvement across the fundraiser, donor and charity experience for one of the UK’s most widely used peer\-to\-peer fundraising platforms.


**What You'll Do**
* Define and advance product vision across the JustGiving fundraising platform, spanning fundraiser, donor, and charity experiences, aligning to long\-term strategic priorities and commercial goals
* Lead end\-to\-end product delivery from discovery and validation through to launch and iteration, working closely with engineering, design, and data teams in an agile environment
* Drive measurable impact by defining and tracking key metrics
* Own and prioritize a multi\-team backlog across concurrent workstreams including platform optimization, new feature development, API program delivery, and regulatory obligations
* Partner cross\-functionally with engineering, design, data, go\-to\-market, and customer success teams to align strategy and deliver high\-quality, customer\-centered solutions
* Identify and act on opportunities for innovation by staying informed on industry trends and emerging technologies including AI\-powered tools
* Shape the future of the JustGiving platform by challenging assumptions, contributing to long\-term roadmap thinking, and representing the product in senior stakeholder forums


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of delivering software products from concept through launch and iteration
* Experience owning a complex, multi\-sided platform product with the ability to balance competing user needs
* Strong knowledge of product lifecycle management, experimentation frameworks, and data\-informed decision\-making, with comfort using analytics tooling such as Heap or Power BI
* Proven ability to define and manage multiple concurrent initiatives, prioritize effectively under pressure, and maintain delivery momentum across cross\-functional teams
* Experience working with or alongside platform/API programs, including partner migration, third\-party integrations, and developer\-facing product considerations
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align engineering, design, commercial, and leadership teams around a shared product vision
* Confident and active use of AI tools as part of everyday product practice, from writing and refining documentation, specs, and communications, through to prototyping concepts and exploring solutions using AI\-assisted tooling
* Able to deliver products that meet required standards of quality, security, and operability, and to work flexible hours as required by business priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Business Platforms, Sales and Support
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of experience with enterprise product management.
* Experience working in a cross\-functional organization and influencing engineers, product managers, or senior executives.
* Engineering or technical experience shipping technical products.
* Strong product management, business acumen, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, data analysis skills and articulate business judgment.


**About the job** 
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 In this role, you will bring the experience, passion, and drive to envision and deliver great user experiences, great platform services, and meaningful impact to customers' businesses. As a part of this role, you will help radically transform what users expect of a contact center through agentic capabilities, insights, ML\-based automation, and platform capabilities. As a part of this role, you will need to go past the obvious, be unafraid to hold an opinion on strategy and direction, and bring the tenacity and conviction to turn into reality. In this role, you will need to be a learner, curious, and articulate someone who is aspirational, bold, and transformative, yet practical and impact focused.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand users and problem domains, articulate business goals, and define crisp execution plans, including product strategy, and roadmap that is detailed, clear, and compelling to users, and clearly defined for our team.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, Program Managers, and other teams to deliver a product that we and our users are proud of and that meets our business or technical goals.
* Earn the trust of our team, of our leaders, and our users, by delivering on our commitments and getting things done.
* Craft new opportunities proactively to improve the lives of our users, and work across the organization to pursue them.
* Maintain a level of curiosity and hunger to learn as the AI technological shifts continue, staying comfortable with change, flexible and adaptable in technical, organizational, and customer shifts.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Avèro Advisors** 




 Avèro Advisors is an industry\-leading independent strategic advisory firm dedicated to helping public sector organizations modernize operations through Digital Government Transformation and ERP/IT modernization. We combine technology expertise with design thinking to solve complex business challenges and help governments deliver better services to their communities.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Junior Product Manager with 2 years of experience to support the planning, development, and enhancement of Avèro's advisory products and AIenabled solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with senior product leaders, consultants, engineers, and public sector stakeholders to translate business needs into product capabilities that improve government operations.
 



  





**Core Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 • Support product strategy and contribute to the evolution of Avèro's advisory products and digital solutions.
 



 • Assist in maintaining the product roadmap by tracking priorities, customer feedback, and business objectives.
 



 • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from internal teams and client stakeholders.
 



 • Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications for engineering teams.
 



 • Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, and feature prioritization under the guidance of senior product leadership.
 



 • Conduct market research and competitive analysis on public sector technology trends and emerging solutions.
 



 • Coordinate with consultants, engineering teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful feature delivery.
 



 • Assist with product demonstrations, testing, user acceptance activities, and release planning.
 



 • Track product performance metrics, gather customer feedback, and prepare reports to support continuous improvement.
 



 • Support cross\-functional communication to ensure alignment between business, technology, and client expectations.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • 2 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, IT Consulting, SaaS, or public sector technology.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Public Administration, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
 



 • Basic understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and product management principles.
 



 • Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
 



 • Experience writing business requirements, user stories, or functional documentation is preferred.
 



 • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams and communicate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Eagerness to learn and grow in a product management career within a consulting environment.
 



  





**Why Avèro Advisors?** 




 Joining Avèro Advisors offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, innovation, and public service. As part of our growing product team, you'll collaborate with experienced advisors, engineers, and public sector experts to develop solutions that support digital transformation, improve government operations, and deliver meaningful outcomes for communities.

 Join Novartis for driving global impact with innovative digital solutions.

* Provides expertise and guidance to the training and change team. When required, delivery of training to end users.
* Analyses the value of feature released and adoption.
* Helps define Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), KPIs, and dashboards relevant to the Product team and various stakeholders.

jobs.title: Product Support Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
   

  

 Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive\-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
   

  

 They will also have strong experience managing a high\-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.
* This role will support the growth and maturity of product support programs by identifying areas of improvement, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to refine support processes, policies, and tooling, and serving as one of the drivers of product support excellence within Customer Experience (CX).
* Manage executive\-level product escalations end\-to\-end, including stakeholder communication, customer updates, and coordination with global product and engineering teams to drive timely and effective resolution.
* The successful candidate should have deep product support expertise, strong experience driving process improvements, and a proven ability to collaborate cross\-functionally, along with experience managing and developing high\-performing teams of product support specialists across multiple levels.
* Analyze data regularly and drive continuous improvement.
* Maintain and report on KPIs and provide ad hoc reporting as necessary.
* Proactively identify areas for improvement and own the implementation of necessary changes to CX support processes. Own, coordinate and ship process improvements in collaboration with the User Ops, and influence on behalf of CX for cross\-functionally owned processes and tools.
* Participate in the global on\-call rotation to cover incidents.


**Skills You'll Need To Bring**
* 8\+ years of work experience in Product support team of a software company.
* 3\+ years of work experience in leading and managing a Product support team.
* You have deep understanding of the nuance of managing product support and executive escalations, and can apply that to improve the customer experience.
* You are extremely user\-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.
* You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.
* Strong technical support foundations, including log reading and basic debugging, core API concepts, webhook fundamentals, and SSO basics (OAuth and SAML).
* Proficiency in incorporating AI into day\-to\-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.
* Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end\-to\-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.
* You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Experience handling business intelligence tools and systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Hex, Looker.
* Experience building robust and scalable processes spanning across go\-to\-market and technical teams.
* Ability to deep dive and own projects individually while also delegating and empowering team members to deliver.
* You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.


**Nice To Haves**
* Experience working in a fast\-paced start\-up environment
* You are familiar with and/or a user of Notion

Ultimately, this role is accountable for the delivery of robust ERP capabilities that enable functional stakeholders to realize maximum value from our SAP ecosystem.

===================

* **Process Ownership:** Own the "Plan\-to\-Produce" or "Source\-to\-Pay" process models, driving digital transformation initiatives within the Materials Management and Production Planning domains.

* **Stakeholder Influence:** Manage stakeholder communication and progress reporting, acting as a bridge between technical execution and business requirements.
* **Mentorship:** Mentor junior team members and provide technical leadership to the global SAP Product Council.

### **Basic Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, IT, Computer Science, or Engineering.
* Professional IT experience with established leadership credentials across SAP ERP product lines.

### **Desired Characteristics**


Technical Expertise


* Deep, hands\-on experience with the **SAP MM or PP** suite of products (including sub\-modules like WM/EWM or Shop Floor Control/Quality Module).

* Strong process knowledge across the **Procurement\-to\-Pay (P2P)** or **Plan\-to\-Produce (P2P)** cycles, including integration with SAP Financials (FICO) and Project Systems (PS).
* Experience with global configuration and highly integrated, multi\-site SAP architectures.

Leadership \& Business Acumen

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
   

  

 At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Institutional Buy Side is responsible for developing and marketing industry\-leading tools for portfolio management, quantitative research, risk, performance \& attribution, and execution management across the investment lifecycle. Our clients include the world’s largest asset managers, asset owners, and insurance companies.
   

  

 The Services organization is focused on evolving FactSet’s global service delivery model by streamlining operational workflows and enhancing data quality, transparency, and efficiency. This includes key service tools such as Portfolio Reconciliation Utility, Portfolio Health, Lifecycle Dashboards, and Portfolio Services Dashboards—tools that underpin FactSet’s growing Managed Services and Portfolio Services business.
   

  

 The Services Product Management team is driving the evolution of our workflow and process monitoring tools. These products ensure transparency into the processing of data into FactSet, validating and ensuring data accuracy and completeness, and outputting the results in presentation ready format.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Product Specialist** 
 with strong interpersonal skills, a thirst for knowledge and the capacity to implement strategic improvements that will continue to grow the Buy\-Side Services product suite at an accelerated rate.
   

  

 This role will have the responsibility of driving product development and influence product strategy as the team builds out the product offering to support performance, reporting and risk workflows.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to be a key player in the growth and success of our Buy\-Side Services, making a significant impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of our clients' operations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Deliver high\-quality, innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product, engineering, and operations to foster a culture of continuous improvement and proactively enhance our offerings.
* Become the SME of Services products and driving the evolution of the products into a seamless experience for our users
* Work directly with clients and internal teams to identify areas for improvement and execute a vision for product success in both the short and long term.
* Contribute to the creation of requirements and specifications for tools and workflow improvements, enabling our support teams to meet the demands of accelerated client growth.
* Manage internal documentation utilized by various departments for product knowledge.
* Collaborate with engineers to fix bugs, test enhancements, and manage releases and client migrations.
* Assist with queries and bugs to ensure timely and accurate responses.
* Work within an Agile environment focused on frequent continuous releases and increased transparency with stakeholders.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4\+ years of industry experience.
* Strong technical, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Creative thinker with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to take ownership of projects and bring them to completion.
* Background in Product Development, Application Design, or a similar role is a plus.


**What's In It For You**
 At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a Fact Setter means:
   

  

* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.


**Company Culture and Benefits:** 
 At our organization, we foster a collaborative and inclusive culture that encourages growth and innovation. We offer competitive benefits and provide ample opportunities for professional development, paving the way for exciting career advancement within the Financial\-Technology industry.
   

  

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
 Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

 FactSet (NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. jobs.description:
**Automation – Business Process re\-engineering \- Advisor**

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Finance Automation Advisor is responsible for identifying, designing, developing, and implementing automation solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across Finance operations. This role serves as a key partner to Finance, Operations, Technology, and other business teams to transform manual processes into automated, sustainable solutions using tools such as Alteryx, SQL, VBA, and other reporting and analytics platforms.


The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, can independently identify opportunities for improvement, and successfully manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. This individual must possess strong analytical skills, a continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse functional teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to automate manual, repetitive, and high\-volume business processes across Finance and related operational functions.
* Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain automation solutions utilizing Alteryx, SQL, VBA, and other automation and reporting technologies.
* Independently lead projects from concept through implementation, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities while consistently meeting deadlines and delivering high\-quality solutions.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements, document processes, and develop scalable solutions that improve operational performance.
* Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and process improvement initiatives.
* Develop and maintain automated reporting, dashboards, and analytical tools that support business decision\-making.
* Create process documentation, technical specifications, and user guides to support long\-term sustainability and knowledge transfer.
* Proactively identify process inefficiencies, control gaps, and operational risks, recommending and implementing solutions that improve accuracy and compliance.
* Support production issues, troubleshoot automation failures, and implement corrective actions to minimize business disruption.
* Promote best practices related to automation, process optimization, data governance, and operational excellence.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **11 to 13** years relevant experience with Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience developing automation solutions using Alteryx, SQL, VBA, and other data management or reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of finance, accounting, operational processes, or business analytics.
* Proven ability to independently initiate, prioritize, and execute projects with minimal supervision.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience working with large and complex data sets and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Self\-Starter and Results\-Oriented
* Project Leadership and Ownership
* Process Improvement and Continuous Innovation
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving
* Time Management and Prioritization
* Adaptability and Change Management
* Technical and Business Acumen
* Strong Communication and Stakeholder Management

**About Evernorth Health Services**


Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, FaaS
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon built world\-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. Finance as a Service (FaaS) is turning that machinery into a product: end\-to\-end back\-office finance and accounting, delivered to sellers and partners as a service. Customers get Amazon\-grade accuracy, controllership, and compliance without building it themselves. We run accounts payable, accounts receivable, record\-to\-report, and tax operations for a growing roster customers today.  

  

The systems that power FaaS today are highly specialized, built to run Amazon's own books and in many ways add odds what other businesses really want and need. FaaS the a product will benefit from an operations stack built with multi\-tenancy, data isolation, multi\-auditor control support built into its foundation from the start. FaaS must scale from large multinationals down to small local business, and its technology must be similarly geared. Scaling FaaS into a durable business requires a deliberate long\-term strategy, and this includes the technology that powers it.
  

  

As Principal Product Manager \- Technical for FaaS, you own that strategy. You will lead end\-to\-end technical due diligence on our existing platforms, define the target multi\-year architecture and roadmap, drive build\-buy\-partner trade\-offs, and drive the right investment cases through the organization. This is a zero\-to\-one charter inside an established finance organization, with company\-level visibility and broad influence across Amazon Finance, AWS, and the Selling Partner ecosystem.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technology strategy and multi\-year platform roadmap for FaaS as a product, feeding directly into FaaS's and FinOps' broader strategy.
* Lead comprehensive technical due diligence on the existing stacks: document current\-state systems and dependencies; identify internal and partner capabilities that can be leveraged, integrated, or extended; evaluate the external landscape; and define the build\-buy\-partner path for each capability area.
* Define the target architecture for a multi\-tenant finance platform that enforces strict per\-customer data isolation, exceeds all audit and controllership standards, and supports complex regulatory needs, for example, multi\-jurisdiction tax and statutory compliance.
* Drive build\-buy\-partner, and integrate decisions with clear technical and economic reasoning; where scale demands it, reduce single\-threaded reliance on internal technologies, drawing commercialization lessons from AWS.
* Make the case for the technology investments needed to deliver the strategy, including unit economics and cost\-to\-serve, and drive buy\-in from senior leadership.
* Shape the technical strategy to launch new new FaaS products offerings in partnership with operators.
* Partner across internal engineering organizations including FinAuto, FinTech, AWS, Selling Partner Services, Tax, Accounting, Controllership. Work with external vendors to align on and deliver necessary capabilities and optimizations.
* Define the metrics that measure FaaS technology success: automation and productivity gains, cost\-to\-serve, time\-to\-onboard new customers, accuracy and compliance, and reliability.
* Build narratives for vision and strategy, PRFAQs, roadmaps, and business review to align the organization and inform high\-velocity decision\-making.

  

About the team  

FinAuto is one of Amazon's largest fintech organizations, building the platforms that capture, compute, transact, and report Amazon's financial events across every business and geography. Finance as a Service productize Amazon's finance capabilities at world scale: delivering end\-to\-end finance and accounting services to customers as a service. We are early, we are growing fast, and we are building the technology foundation that will determine how fast and far FaaS can scale. This is a rare opportunity to define a new platform for a new business, from the ground up.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above
* 10\+ years of software management experience, with 3\+ years at Principal or equivalent scope
* Demonstrated success and strong execution track record for building world\-class products
* Demonstrated experience partnering closely with engineers, designers, and external partners to build products and complex systems at scale
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience driving build / buy / partner technology decisions and making the investment case for them
* Experience delivering products or platforms across multiple geographies or jurisdictions
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Exceptional analytical skills and experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments, and using data to measure product impact
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast\-paced startup environment
* Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA, MS in Computer Science, or equivalent advanced degree
* Experience building multi\-tenant SaaS or platform products that serve external customers with strict data\-isolation and audit requirements
* Experience leading 0\-to\-1 or greenfield product initiatives with broad organizational impact
* Experience building product vision and strategy narratives, PRFAQs, and product updates for senior leadership
* Experience in fintech, payments, money, finops teams.

jobs.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
   

  

**Itron** 
 is a global technology company. We build solutions that help utilities measure, manage and analyze energy and water. Our broad product portfolio includes electricity, gas, water and thermal energy measurement and control technology; communications systems; software; and professional services. With thousands of employees supporting nearly 8,000 utilities in more than 100 countries, Itron empowers utilities to responsibly and efficiently manage energy and water resources. Join us in creating a more resourceful world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're hiring a Product Manager III to join Itron's EP\&R (Emergency Preparedness and Response) product team, based in our Bangalore office. EP\&R is one of Itron's most critical solutions, helping utilities plan for and respond to severe weather events and large\-scale outages.
   

  

 You'll report to our Lead PM and partner closely with engineering teams in Bangalore and Thailand. The role is intentionally placed in Bangalore for time zone alignment and collaboration with both teams. As a core member of EP\&R product \- your primary focus will be our
 **Storm Manager** 
 ,
 **Storm Impact** 
 , and
 **Callout** 
 applications, with opportunities to contribute to platform initiatives as we build more horizontal capabilities across EP\&R and adjacent product lines.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the roadmap for Storm Manager, Storm Impact, and Callout. Prioritize the backlog, plan releases, and align delivery to company goals.
* Drive discovery. Interview customers, partner with internal SMEs, and validate solutions through experimentation before committing engineering capacity.
* Prototype to learn faster. Use AI\-assisted tools (Claude, Cursor, Replit, Figma Make etc.) to mockup flows, test ideas with customers, and de\-risk decisions before they hit a sprint.
* Translate problems into shippable solutions. Write clear user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can execute without ambiguity.
* Operate cross\-functionally across BLR, Thailand, and US\-based PM, engineering, design, and implementation teams. You won't have direct reports; your influence comes from clarity and follow\-through.
* Measure what ships. Track adoption, outcomes, and customer feedback. Adjust direction based on evidence, not opinion.
* Contribute to platform thinking. As we scale horizontal solutions across EP\&R, help identify capabilities that should live at the platform layer vs. the product layer.
* Stakeholder Communication. Own the communication rythm around roadmap progress, release milestones, and key decisions proactively surfacing risks and trade\-offs so leadership can make informed business decisions.
* 5\+ years in product management, with at least part of that in vertical B2B SaaS serving enterprise customers. (Required)


**Customer\-fluent.** 
 You're comfortable in the room with utility operations teams and can translate operational workflows into scalable solutions.
   

  

**Technically credible.** 
 You don't write production code, but you can hold your own on architecture, integrations, data flows, and modern AI/ML concepts with engineering.
   

  

**Hands\-on with AI tooling.** 
 You actively use AI coding and prototyping tools as part of your PM workflow — to draft specs, build clickable prototypes, query data, and accelerate discovery. You treat these as leverage, not novelty.
   

  

**Sharp writer.** 
 Your PRDs leave little room for interpretation. You can also defend a decision to a skeptical exec in three sentences.
   

  

**Organized under pressure.** 
 You keep dependencies visible and priorities tight across distributed teams without becoming a bottleneck.
   

  

**Adaptable.** 
 You operate well in a fast\-paced environment where scope shifts and processes are still being built.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in a technology\-related field, or equivalent experience.
   

  

 Domain experience in utility operations, outage management, storm/weather modeling, or field operations.
   

  

 Experience working on or with platform teams supporting multiple product lines.
   

  

 Experience shipping functional prototypes or internal tools yourself using AI\-Assisted tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, etc.) — bonus if you've used them to validate a feature pre\-engineering.
   

  

 Experience integrating with third\-party enterprise systems
   

  

 Track record shipping enterprise applications used in both field and office environments.
   

  

 Willingness to travel to the US and Thailand for customer visits and team offsites.
   

  

 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!
   

  

 The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.
   

  

 Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1\-800\-635\-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.
   

  

 Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

jobs.description:
**Here’s a summary of the role:**
 If you’re a product manager who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and wants to shape how organisations handle ethics and compliance in this new AI\-enabled era, this role puts you right in the middle of it. You’ll own a whistleblowing and case management platform used by major enterprises, working closely with engineering teams in London and Bangalore to create and ship features that differentiate our product from the competition – from employee reporting tools to AI\-powered investigation workflows. This is a fast\-moving environment where you’ll need to be comfortable with complexity, technically curious, and confident communicating across every level of the business. It’s a one\-year fixed term contract covering maternity leave, with a realistic possibility of extension or permanence for the right person.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff):**
* Own the product roadmap for a whistleblowing and case management platform (Vault/Speak Up), working with one other product manager and a team of 6–12 engineers to define, prioritise, and ship features
* Work with engineering daily to translate business requirements into well\-scoped, deliverable work – managing trade\-offs between speed and scope coverage in a fast\-moving environment
* Collaborate across a portfolio of Ethics \& Compliance products including policy management, compliance training, and conflicts of interest – ensuring your product connects into a broader vision
* Engage with product marketing, senior stakeholders, and commercial teams to communicate what you’re building, why it matters, and what’s coming next
* Conceptualise and shape AI\-powered product features – you won’t just be managing a backlog, you’ll be actively ideating how AI can transform compliance workflows
* Pick up and run with a knowledge transfer from the outgoing PM, getting up to speed quickly on a platform that’s been substantially modernised in the last 12 months


**These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:**
* Demonstrable experience as a product manager in a B2B SaaS environment, owning a product end\-to\-end from discovery through delivery
* Strong technical communication – you can hold a detailed conversation with engineers about APIs, databases, and integrations, and then switch to presenting strategy to senior leadership without missing a beat
* AI fluency – you understand what LLMs are, how AI capabilities can be embedded in products, and can think critically about where AI adds real value versus noise
* Comfort with ambiguity and pace – you’re the kind of PM who creates structure where there is none, and you don’t wait to be told what to do
* Excellent stakeholder management – you can build trust quickly, navigate competing priorities, and communicate clearly across product, engineering, design, and commercial teams
* A bias toward action – you ship, you iterate, you learn, and you don’t let perfect be the enemy of good


**It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t:**
* Experience in GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance), legal tech, or ethics and compliance software
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools for product management – prototyping with tools like v0, Claude or similar to accelerate your workflow
* Familiarity with working across distributed engineering teams (London and Bangalore in this case)
* Experience with whistleblowing, case management, or employee reporting platforms


**About Us**
 Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C\-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.
   

  

 At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly \- those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future \- you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.
   

  

 Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook
   

  

**What Diligent Offers You**
* Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
* We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
* We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
* Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. **PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL \| FINKRAFT.AI**
 Location: Bengaluru, HSR \| Full\-time \| Level: L4 \| Reports to: CPO / BU Head
   

  

**About Finkraft.ai**
 Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250\+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr\+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1\.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.
   

  

 The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it.
   

  

**THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING**
 A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived.
   

  

 This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it.
   

  

**What You Will Own In 90 Days**
* Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node.
* Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs.
* One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development.


**Key Responsibilities**
 Product Strategy and Roadmap
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why
* Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions
* Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence
* Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped


 Field Ecosystem Engagement
   

  

* Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP)
* Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability
* Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs


 Ecosystem Integration Ownership
   

  

* Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS â GDS/OTA/TMC â Concur/expense tool â bank/payment â Finkraft â GST claim
* Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff
* Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go\-live
* Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why


 PRD and Engineering Partnership
   

  

* Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics
* Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review
* Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria
* Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision


 Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration
   

  

* Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item
* Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix
* Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room
* Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS


 Market and Regulatory Intelligence
   

  

* Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e\-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates
* Monitor hotel\-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates
* Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives?


**Requirements**
**REQUIREMENTS**
 Must Have
   

  

* 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS
* Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews

* Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production
* Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand\-holding in every stand\-up
* Comfort with field\-heavy, travel\-intensive work across India

* Own Haleon's SAP BTP vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform governance.

* Define platform standards, guardrails, architecture principles, and operating policies.
* Implement ERP technical landscape roadmap and operation.

* Lead internal teams, service providers, and strategic partners responsible for platform delivery and operations.

* Establish secure\-by\-design principles across the ERP landscape.
* Ensure compliance with SOX, ITGC, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead vulnerability management, platform hardening, and audit readiness activities.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage stakeholders across business, IT, SAP, and strategic partners.
* Influence senior technology leaders to drive platform adoption.
* Manage critical escalations and ensure effective governance at Director and VP levels.

**Experience \& Skills**

**Required**

* 15\+ years of SAP/ERP technology leadership experience, with deep expertise in cloud, RISE and Microsoft hyperscaler based platform strategy and operations.
* Proven experience establishing and leading SAP BTP or equivalent cloud platform practices.
* Strong knowledge of SAP architecture, governance, security, and operations.
* Experience with SAP RISE, S/4HANA, Integration Suite, SAP Build Zone, HANA Cloud, Cloud ALM, and SAP extensibility frameworks.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Product Owner**
**BASIC SUMMARY:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely , high\-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI\-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Backlog Ownership \& Agile Execution**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well\-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals
* Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer\-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member
* Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and release


**Requirements Gathering \& User Story Development**
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements
* Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories
* Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and feasibility
* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution
* Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals
* Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed
* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations


**Healthcare Domain Support**
* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams
* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product features


**Minimum Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business , Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2\+ years of product management experience ; healthcare technology or claims administration preferred
* 2\+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements engineering, or business analysis preferred
* Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology
* Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools to help structure requirements and analyze user input (preferred but not required )
* Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints
* Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification
* Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)
